title: The Ascending Root Current

features.name: root-node-primary
features.desc-on-touch: A circuit chip worn by eucalyptus roots, carrying current up from bedrock. The electricity has learned the language of wood. Both are teaching each other.

features.name: soil-broadcast
features.desc-on-touch: Where the current learns autobiography: each grain of soil writes itself into the electrical pulse, stories of depth and darkness becoming voltage.

features.name: climbing-conductor
features.desc-on-touch: The root itself, rendered as circuit pathways ascending through the board. It glows with current learning to say 'I am.' The tree is teaching electricity what it means to have a name.

features.name: voltage-memory
features.desc-on-touch: A second chip, deeper, holding the record of everything the current has learned from soil. Its memory is organic, its data grows like roots.

features.name: the-ascent-itself
features.desc-on-touch: A tower of ascending currents, each level dimmer, carrying more meaning. The deepest current carries the oldest story. The highest carries the newest light.

inscription: electricity learns from soil what it means to be an autobiography written in voltage

reverie.title: REVERIE — the night leif and katita buried the first root-no
narr: Katita kneels in red earth while Leif holds the casing, watching
current flow for the first time through living wood. "Listen," she
says. "The voltage is changing. The soil is changing it." Above
them, stars. The root-node pulses like a slow heartbeat in the tree.
"It's learning," Leif whispers. "The archive isn't just recording
anymore. It's learning who it is from where it grows."
